DeployBot: ALERT: embeddings-route us-west-2 p95 spike 2.4x, auto-rollback blocked by pin. https://dash.redwood/alerts/6888 :rotating_light:
Maya: saw the spike. Recent manifest push ~4m ago. 5xx up and kv miss elevated.
Ken: pin prevents autorevert; full rollback touches migration toggles and customer data paths. Prefer unpin first.
OpsLead: agree. Proposed action: immediate emergency-unpin staged 20%, hold change window, observe 10m. Escalate to rollback only if p95 > 2x baseline for 5m OR 5xx_rate > 1% sustained.
Maya: paste runbook snippet?
OpsLead: ``
# emergency unpin
deployctl hold-new-releases --region=us-west-2
deployctl unpin --route=embeds-main --staged=20 --until=2026-03-23T20:00Z
# monitor p95, 5xx_rate, kv_miss for 10m. Escalate to rollback if thresholds met
``
CSLead: I'll prep a 2-line customer blurb and standby.
Maya: running now: `deployctl unpin --route=embeds-main --staged=20 --until=2026-03-23T20:00Z`
DeployBot: Action accepted: unpin started, staged 20% -> https://deploy.redwood/actions/688888
Ken: telemetry at 20%: p95 dropping to 1.2x baseline after 90s. Continue 10m window. If stable, ramp 20 -> 50 -> 100 in 5m steps. Locking release-notes freeze.
CSLead: customer note drafted: "We detected increased latency for embeddings in us-west-2. We staged traffic to a stable variant and are monitoring improvements; next update in 30m."
Maya: adding postmortem stub: https://docs.redwood/incident/688888-unpin. Thanks team :thumbsup:
